facts.conditions: Margin between the AO3401A |VGS| absolute maximum (fact-umw-ao3401a-vgs, 12 V) and the calculated Q1 |Vgs| when VBEN is asserted (U1.16 driven low) with VBUS_IN at the factory-default, unreprogrammed STUSB4500 PDO3 voltage of 20 V (doc/src/content/docs/inbox/nvm-programming.md factory NVM defaults table: PDO3=20V/1.0A, highest priority) and the as-designed R11(100 kOhm)/R12(56 kOhm) gate divider (fact-umw-ao3401a-gate-resistor-values): the gate node sits at VBUS_IN*R12/(R11+R12) and Vgs = that node minus VBUS_IN (source) = -VBUS_IN*R11/(R11+R12) is approximately -12.82 V. Negative margin means the datasheet's +/-12 V abs-max is exceeded by about 0.82 V on a factory-default (unreprogrammed) NVM, before any 15V-only reprogram is applied. VBUS_IN and R11/R12 are project design values, not manufacturer-primary AO3401A evidence, and are hardcoded as literals in this calculation rather than as separate depends_on facts, matching the component-ss34-c8678 D3-reverse-margin pattern; only the 12 V limit is externally sourced. This is an epic-investigation finding; the wave-6 decision task decides the provision (NVM reprogram-before-first-attach gate, a resistor-value change, an added clamp/limiter, or another mitigation) -- this fact only records the numbers.
